scenes.text: Imagine walking up to a mysterious, blood-red lake in Tanzania and discovering perfectly preserved, stony statues of dead birds and bats frozen in place like eerie, gothic art.
While you might easily think some dark, ancient magic is at play here, the actual science behind this deadly body of hazardous water is somehow even weirder and more terrifying.
The water in Lake Natron is so highly alkaline that it chemically burns the skin and eyes of most creatures, while a natural compound called sodium carbonate slowly calcifies their bodies.
This incredible chemical reaction turns the fallen animals into literal, dusty mummies that look like solid stone, so tell me in the comments if you would dare to visit and follow for more.
